- Complete 500 post demo corpus

- Reader, feed, and header polish
- Recognize Facebook login and keep provider advanced controls accessible
- Shared package test coverage in integration restored
- Release build and type-safety cleanup
- Capture and verify showcase graph pixels
- Select friend title during showcase capture
- Sample thumbnails and clarify cloud sync settings restored
- Preserve PWA Google OAuth redirect URI
- Exclude Facebook ads from capture

### Follow-ups

- Label reader focus mode and explain its purpose

- Cross-compile Intel releases on Apple Silicon
- Reverse-integrate v26.9.803 and publish README showcase
- Yield during desktop mock snapshot encoding
- Isolate desktop scroll benchmark overhead
- Enforce initiative and decision review
- Compact map cards and preserve location markers

### Downloads

**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
